lines.t: (Verse 1)
I was running in circles,
Trying to find my way.
I kept making the same mistakes I made,
Like my life was on replay.
I thought my chance was over,
Thought I’d gone too far.
Carried all this guilt inside me,
Like a weight around my heart.
Every door felt shut on me,
Every prayer just hit the floor,
But in the silence, I heard You say,
“You’re not who you were before.”
(Chorus)
It’s not the end, it’s not the end,
Even now You pull me in.
When I thought I was too broken,
You fixed me up again.
I was lost inside the noise,
Every wrong turn I’d been through,
I gave up on myself,
But You never gave up too.
(Verse 2)
I thought You'd turn me away,
Because of all I'd done.
Every promise that I broke,
Every place I tried to run.
I was hiding in the shadows,
Afraid to face the truth.
But You kept on loving me,
You called me to You.
(Pre-Chorus)
I thought I knew what You’d say,
About all the wrong I did,
But Your voice cut through the silence,
Like a hope I couldn’t miss.
(Chorus)
It’s not the end, it’s not the end,
Even now You pull me in.
When I thought I was too broken,
You fixed me up again.
I was lost inside the noise,
Every wrong turn I’d been through,
I gave up on myself,
But You never gave up too.
(Bridge)
I stopped running, I let go,
At my lowest, You came close.
What I thought was the end
Was You calling me home.
You never gave up on me,
Even when I made the wrong choice.
You kept calling out to me,
Even when I ignored Your voice.
When I tried to push You aside,
You still held out Your hand.
When I was broken You lifted me up,
When I was weak You helped me stand.
(Tag / Outro lines)
It’s not the end, I see it now,
Your love was stronger than my doubt.
I’m still here because You are.
Cause You kept me in Your heart.
